n9e01720074.headline: The IBEX 35 loses the psychological barrier of 10,200 points
n9e01720074.summary: The Spanish IBEX 35 index dropped below the psychological 10,200 level following the outcome of the Catalan regional elections.
n9e01720074.why: The IBEX 35 is Spain's benchmark stock index; political uncertainty in Catalonia can affect investor confidence and market stability in Spain and Europe.

impacts.name: IBEX 35
impacts.why: Political uncertainty from Catalan elections reduced investor confidence, leading to index decline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n9e01720074.why_moved: The Catalan election results increased political risk perceptions, prompting selling pressure on Spanish equities.

n0d0e131539.headline: Iraq once again controls own economy, free of UN sanctions
n0d0e131539.summary: Iraq is poised for foreign investments and economic opening following the lifting of decades-long UN sanctions imposed after the invasion of Kuwait.
n0d0e131539.why: Sanctions relief can lead to increased foreign investment and economic growth, impacting regional stability and energy markets.

nb124c8b1f1.headline: Loan forgiveness cut back for defrauded students
nb124c8b1f1.summary: Student loan borrowers defrauded by their schools may receive only partial loan forgiveness depending on their income levels.
nb124c8b1f1.why: Changes to student loan forgiveness policies affect borrower finances and the education lending market.

n754603f756.headline: Bitcoin slides below $13,000 as crypto mania grows – up more than 1,100% YTD
n754603f756.summary: Bitcoin’s price dropped as much as 21 percent, extending its loss from recent highs and reflecting increased crypto market volatility.
n754603f756.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market cap; its price swings influence the broader digital asset market and investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Price drop reflects profit-taking and increased market volatility.

nfc1119b56b.headline: EMERGING MARKETS-Mexico peso hits 9-month low on corruption scandal, U.S. tax plan
nfc1119b56b.summary: The Mexican peso fell to a nine-month low due to a U.S. tax overhaul and domestic corruption scandals boosting a leftist front-runner.
nfc1119b56b.why: Currency fluctuations driven by political and fiscal developments in Mexico affect trade, investment, and market sentiment for investors in emerging markets.
nfc1119b56b.why_moved: The peso weakened due to concerns over domestic corruption and the impact of U.S. tax reforms on Mexico's economy and trade relations.
